title: Dispensing medication processed outside the pharmacy's licensed premises under 247 CMR 9.04(11)
subtopic: Processing outside the licensed pharmacy premises
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.04(11) a pharmacy may not dispense any medication that was processed outside its licensed pharmacy premises unless said process was verified by a Massachusetts licensed pharmacist or performed in a pharmacy licensed by the Board.
exam_relevance: Tests the two alternative conditions, each attached to the off-site process, on which a pharmacy may dispense medication processed outside its licensed premises.
common_confusions: The conditions are alternatives: verification of the process by a Massachusetts licensed pharmacist, or performance of the process in a pharmacy licensed by the Board.
Each condition attaches to the process; an inspection of the finished product at the dispensing pharmacy is not stated as satisfying either.
A pharmacy licensed only by another state does not meet the second condition, which requires a pharmacy licensed by the Board.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-17 in the current official PDF of 247 CMR 9.00 on mass.gov (pages dated 12/6/24).
